Title: Buying 1,000 coins for 30 gems moves the exact amounts
Priority reason: Currency exchange: every number must be exact
Preconditions: Fresh save, then 100 gems and 0 coins (debug: zero, then gems)
Steps:
1. Open the Store
2. Tap the 1,000 coins pack (30 gems)
Expected result:
1. Gems 100 -> 70, coins 0 -> 1,000, in the HUD and in the save (localStorage pixelswarm.save.v1)
2. Toast '+1,000 coins'
Automation reason: Exact numbers readable from the save; runs on every change

Title: A player who owns No Ads is not sold No Ads again in the Special Offer
Priority reason: Charging twice for an entitlement is a refund and trust problem
Steps:
1. Open the Store
2. Look at the Special Offer card
Expected result: 1. The offer either hides No Ads, shows it as owned, or is replaced; its price is not charged for No Ads again
Automation reason: Cheap check once the rule is decided
Source: R-STORE-4 and R-STORE-5: the No Ads card checks state.noAds (js/app.js:324) but the offer card (js/app.js:314-318) does not; the offer pop-up does (js/app.js:698)
Assumption: An owned entitlement should not be sold again (Q-01)
